   proposed=m.encode({'test_fixture':True,'owner':owner,'value':1})
   m.atomic(candidate,proposed);after={**m.ref(candidate),'bytes':len(proposed)}

   replacements.append(dict(destination=destination,before=before,candidate=after,exact_inverse={**m.ref(inverse),'bytes':m.path(inverse).stat().st_size}))
